annotations.title: List Pinterest audiences and customer lists

description: List the Pinterest AUDIENCES on the ad account (what:"audiences", default) or its CUSTOMER LISTS (what:"customer_lists"), or read one by audienceId / customerListId. An audience id is what an ad group’s targetingSpec takes as {"AUDIENCE_INCLUDE":[id]} (retarget) or AUDIENCE_EXCLUDE (suppress). READY delivers; TOO_SMALL (under 100 people) never does. ownership:"RECEIVED" lists audiences shared with this account. Read-only, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

audienceId.description: read one audience in full by its id

customerListId.description: read one customer list in full by its id

ownership.description: OWNED or RECEIVED; RECEIVED lists audiences shared with this account

name: list_pinterest_ads_audiences
title: List Pinterest audiences and customer lists
